escapes.title: Tool reports success while embedding an error in output
escapes.rootCause: Tool implementations self-certified contradictory result envelopes
escapes.brokenInvariant: success=true must contain no structured or embedded error
escapes.whyTestsMissed: Tests exercised happy-path output but not contradictory envelopes
escapes.generalizedCampaign: property-generate malformed ToolResult envelopes and require StrictToolRegistry rejection

escapes.title: CAS value mutated through a returned nested reference
escapes.rootCause: Read methods copied wrappers but retained mutable payload references
escapes.brokenInvariant: all authority reads are detached or immutable
escapes.whyTestsMissed: Tests checked expectedVersion but did not mutate nested return values
escapes.generalizedCampaign: deep mutation corpus over every public read/query/history API

escapes.title: Current-row temporal memory represented as bi-temporal history
escapes.rootCause: recordedAt was stored while historical revisions were overwritten
escapes.brokenInvariant: knownAt queries must see only facts recorded by that system time
escapes.whyTestsMissed: Tests queried latest state and did not compare historical knowledge cutoffs
escapes.generalizedCampaign: append/supersede/contradict across validAt and knownAt matrix in memory and Postgres

escapes.title: PR closed was interpreted as deployment success
escapes.rootCause: Webhook projection collapsed command and outcome semantics
escapes.brokenInvariant: observed command, accepted transition and external outcome are distinct events
escapes.whyTestsMissed: Fixtures covered event names but not semantic lifecycle truth
escapes.generalizedCampaign: semantic provider fixture matrix for commands and outcomes

escapes.title: Historical command replay could be re-decided under new state-machine rules
escapes.rootCause: Replay re-executed commands instead of applying recorded accepted/rejected outcomes
escapes.brokenInvariant: replay reproduces recorded historical outcomes and never reinterprets the past
escapes.generalizedCampaign: change reducer/state-machine rules after recording outcomes and require identical replay state

escapes.title: Automatic CI was disabled by deleting much of the verification matrix
escapes.rootCause: Cost-control objective was implemented as workflow simplification rather than trigger separation
escapes.brokenInvariant: manual-only execution must preserve verification breadth
escapes.whyTestsMissed: No workflow self-contract compared old and new suite coverage
escapes.generalizedCampaign: manifest every required suite and prove workflow references all of them

escapes.title: W13 certified only one of two divergent sibling branches
escapes.rootCause: Mental lineage model treated PR #35 as continuation/superset of PR #34
escapes.brokenInvariant: qualification lineage must contain every selected capability and exact source provenance
escapes.whyTestsMissed: No graph-level ancestor/capability completeness check existed
adjacentFailureFamily: stacked PR based on moving branch
escapes.generalizedCampaign: lineage DAG + capability manifest completeness validator

escapes.title: Provider evidence hash was accepted without independent recomputation
escapes.rootCause: Wrapper checked presence and bound fields but delegated evidence integrity to the provider adapter
escapes.brokenInvariant: authority accepts provider evidence only after canonical content hash verification and operation binding
escapes.whyTestsMissed: Contracts used honest fixtures with matching evidenceHash
escapes.generalizedCampaign: tamper, swap and replay provider evidence across operations and timestamps

escapes.title: Post-commit evidence or lease-release failure existed only in process memory
escapes.rootCause: Protected provider truth and secondary repair duties were not separate durable aggregates
escapes.brokenInvariant: accepted provider truth is immutable while every failed secondary duty becomes durable repair work
escapes.whyTestsMissed: Success tests ended before process restart
escapes.generalizedCampaign: crash after provider commit at every subsequent boundary and resume repair worker

escapes.title: Documentation routed successors to stale branches and next actions
escapes.rootCause: Multiple manually maintained continuity documents had no shared source revision or compiler
escapes.brokenInvariant: all current documents identify the same exact branch, head, blockers and frontier
escapes.whyTestsMissed: Documentation had no executable drift test
escapes.generalizedCampaign: mutate one document pointer and require control-plane validation failure

law: Every escaped bug must retain a permanent regression test and at least one generalized adjacent-failure campaign.
